config.title: Scoring configuration
config.readOnlyNote: Read-only — your edits stay local. Officers can deploy a shared config.
config.formulaNote: T1, T2 and T3 (both kills and deaths) are ignored — only T4 and T5 contribute to DKP.
config.flatDesc: Single target applied to every player, regardless of power.
config.tieredDescA: Each player falls into the highest tier whose
config.scopeDesc: Only the top N players by power get a target. The rest are marked Unranked.
config.ruleDesc: Which ratio drives the status: both requirements, only KP, or only Deaths.
config.ruleBothTitle: Status = min(KP%, Deaths%). Player must hit both.
config.ruleKpTitle: Status ignores deaths — only KP ratio counts.
config.ruleDeathsTitle: Status ignores KP — only deaths ratio counts.

columnHelp.power: Current power from the uploaded scan. Sets which tier the player falls into.
columnHelp.tier: Power band the player lands in — the highest tier whose min-power ≤ their power. The tier sets the KP and Deaths targets. '—' means no tier (below the lowest tier, or outside the top-N cutoff) → UNRANKED.
columnHelp.t4Deaths: Raw T4 troop deaths from the scan.
columnHelp.t5Deaths: Raw T5 troop deaths from the scan.
columnHelp.t4Kills: Raw T4 kills from the scan.
columnHelp.t5Kills: Raw T5 kills from the scan.
columnHelp.kp: Raw total kill points from the scan. This is the number the KP % column measures against target (not the DKP score).
columnHelp.dkp: Weighted combat score = T5d×w + T4d×w + T5k×w + T4k×w, using the weights in Scoring configuration. Informational only — it does NOT set the status. Hover a DKP cell for that player's breakdown.
columnHelp.kpPct: Raw KP ÷ KP target, where KP target = tier's KP multiplier × power. 100% = exactly on target. Color follows the status cutoffs (green/amber/red). Hover a cell for that player's target and actual.
columnHelp.deathsPct: Total deaths ÷ deaths target, where deaths target = tier's deaths-% of power. 100% = exactly on target. Color follows the status cutoffs.
columnHelp.status: Grade from the status cutoffs applied to the driving ratio. Scoring rule decides the driver: 'both' uses the lower of KP % and Deaths % (both must be met), or KP-only / Deaths-only. EXCELLENT ≥ approved ≥ good; below that → REVIEW.
